description: a young woman with warm brown skin and long black hair in a high ponytail falling down her back, a silver tiara with a blue gem, a calm pretty young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, a small straight nose and closed lips, ornate silver and white plate armour with gold trim and a glowing star on the chest, a long dark blue cloak full of stars and purple mist hanging behind from the shoulders, silver boots, one long white and gold bow strapped upright on the back behind the shoulder, the whole bow above the waist and behind the body, never in front of the legs, nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the ponytail to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, headwear, armour, cloak and colours; the hands empty, the bow strapped on the back
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
